With a strong network of over 100 global partners, we build meaningful international relationships that deliver real-world impact. We work with like-minded institutions to tackle global challenges, grow research and create international opportunities for students and staff. Our vision is to be a world-leading applied university. As we expand our global network, we focus on delivering transformational experiences. Each partnership is unique and built to provide mutual benefit. On this page: Our global partnership programmes Transnational education partnerships Strategic partnerships Study exchange Virtual exchange Partner with us Our global partnership programmes We engage in a range of global partnerships, including transnational education (TNE), strategic collaborations, study exchange programmes, and virtual mobility initiatives. These partnerships strengthen our global presence, enabling academic excellence and knowledge-sharing across continents. We are also a founder member and proud partner of Northern Consortium (NCUK) which has been providing international students with a pathway into UK university programmes since 1987. Transnational education partnerships We collaborate with leading institutions worldwide to offer Transnational Education (TNE), allowing students to earn a Sheffield Hallam degree without relocating to the UK. Find out more about our TNE partners. Strategic partnerships We establish strategic partnerships based on shared values and a commitment to applied learning and global impact. La Trobe University, Australia: Our collaboration fosters student exchanges, joint research and innovative teaching initiatives, strengthening the academic experience for both institutions. Kyiv National University of Technologies and Design (KNUTD), Ukraine : In response to the Russian invasion of Ukraine, we twinned with KNUTD to provide support for Ukrainian students and academics. Study exchange Our exchange partner network enables our students to spend a semester studying at one of our global partner universities – enhancing their academic, cultural and professional experience. We also welcome incoming students from our partner universities to spend a semester or full academic year studying on our international exchange programme. Find out more about our exchange opportunities for Sheffield Hallam students and incoming students as part of our exchange partner network . Virtual exchange We are committed to providing an inclusive international experience for all our students. Virtual Exchange (VE) or Collaborative Online International Learning (COIL) is an educational approach that leverages technology to connect students and educators across borders, enabling collaborative, cross-cultural learning without the need for physical travel. We encourage all courses to embed VE/COIL and look forward to expanding these opportunities and working closely with our partners. Partner with us Interested in partnering with Sheffield Hallam University? Contact us at global@shu.ac.uk to explore opportunities. View open days Apply through an agent Choosing to study in the UK, whether with us or somewhere else, is one of the most important decisions you can make. To support with this decision, some students consider using the services of an education agent when applying to us. Education agents provide a range of services to support you - from identifying the right university and course to guiding you through the application and enrolment process. They can also assist with visa applications, travel, and accommodation arrangements. If you are considering using an education agent, we recommend reading the student and parent guide to choosing an education agent , — an important part of the UK Agent Quality Framework (AQF). The guide provides you and your family with clear information and guidance on what you should look for when considering using an agent. It includes key questions to ask, signs of quality, and how to avoid poor practices. The guide also links to ‘The national code of ethical practice for UK education agents’ and the British Council’s UK database of certified counsellors. You can view a list of our approved recruitment agents . If we don't have an office or representative in your region, contact international@shu.ac.uk . We highly value your feedback.
